name: Elsewhere
status_note: Official FAQ live; Songkick/TickPick list shows through Oct–Nov 2026. Official site has moved from elsewherebrooklyn.com to elsewhere.club (old domain redirects). No public phone; email info@elsewhere.club.

dress.detail: The official FAQ lists no dress code; one third-party listing describes it as casual.

age.value: 16+ to 21+ depending on event; under-16 never admitted. Scannable US government photo ID or passport required (internationals: passport only); no expired IDs or photocopies

cover.value: Ticketed per event; Oct 2026 listings ran about $10–36, with some headliner tiers up to ~$100. Door tickets after the event starts have no fees

getting_in.value: Buy tickets on Eventbrite or at the door; bags inspected, mandatory bag check at big events. Zone One/Loft/Rooftop use the left courtyard entrance; Hall uses the right corridor entrance

hours.value: Varies by event; usually closes around midnight Mon–Thu, 4am Fri–Sat, 11pm Sun

accessibility.value: Fully wheelchair accessible including the rooftop; some elevator areas need a staff escort. Reserved seating can be arranged via info@elsewhere.club or security at the door

subway.value: L to Jefferson St (~5 min walk) or Morgan Ave (~10 min); B57 bus stops at Flushing/Johnson Aves

skip_if: You dislike lines and crowds: reviewers advise queuing early for weekend rooftop parties, and the Hall holds about 600.
You want a polished cocktail experience: it is a loud, large warehouse venue with drinks served in plastic cups.
